import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.regression.mixed_linear_model import MixedLM
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Identify regional MHW years
# Compute region-level mean and SD of SST
stats = df.groupby('region')['mean_sst'].agg(['mean', 'std']).reset_index()
stats['threshold'] = stats['mean'] + 2 * stats['std']
# Compute region-year mean SST
dry = df.groupby(['region', 'year'])['mean_sst'].mean().reset_index()
dry = dry.merge(stats[['region', 'threshold']], on='region')
dry['is_mhw'] = dry['mean_sst'] > dry['threshold']
# List of MHW events
events_list = dry[dry['is_mhw']][['region', 'year']].rename(columns={'year': 'mhw_year'})

# 3. Compute functional redundancy in 2014
df2014 = df[df['year'] == 2014]
# Presence of species per reef
pres = df2014[df2014['biomass'] > 0].drop_duplicates(['id_reef', 'species'])
# Define functional group as floor of trophic level
df2014['func_group'] = np.floor(df2014['trophic_level'])
pres_fg = df2014[df2014['biomass'] > 0].drop_duplicates(['id_reef', 'species', 'func_group'])
# Compute redundancy
r2014 = pres_fg.groupby('id_reef').agg(
    species_richness=('species', 'nunique'),
    n_funcs=('func_group', 'nunique')
).reset_index()
r2014['R2014'] = r2014['species_richness'] / r2014['n_funcs']

# 4. Compute total biomass by reef-year
bio_ry = df.groupby(['id_reef', 'region', 'year'])['biomass'].sum().reset_index()

# 5. For each MHW event, get biomass in MHW year and post-MHW year
# Merge MHW events with biomass
evt = events_list.merge(bio_ry, left_on=['region', 'mhw_year'], right_on=['region', 'year'])
evt = evt.rename(columns={'biomass': 'biomass_mhw'})
# Compute post-MHW year
evt['year_post'] = evt['mhw_year'] + 1
# Merge with biomass to get post-MHW biomass
evt = evt.merge(bio_ry.rename(columns={'year': 'year_post', 'biomass': 'biomass_post'}),
                 on=['id_reef', 'region', 'year_post'], how='left')
# Retain events with post-MHW data
evt = evt.dropna(subset=['biomass_post'])
# Compute biomass change
evt['biomass_change'] = evt['biomass_post'] - evt['biomass_mhw']

# 6. Merge with R2014
df_events = evt.merge(r2014[['id_reef', 'R2014']], on='id_reef', how='left').dropna(subset=['R2014'])

# Deliverable 1: Table of R2014 and biomass changes
print("Summary of redundancy and biomass change for MHW events:")
print(df_events[['id_reef', 'region', 'mhw_year', 'R2014', 'biomass_mhw', 'biomass_post', 'biomass_change']].head())

# 7. Fit mixed model: biomass_change ~ R2014 + random intercepts for region and reef
mixed = MixedLM.from_formula(
    'biomass_change ~ R2014',
    groups='id_reef',
    vc_formula={'region': '0 + C(region)'},
    data=df_events
)
mixed_res = mixed.fit(reml=False)

# Deliverable 2: Model summary
print("\nMixed model results:")
print(mixed_res.summary())

# 8. Scatter plot with regression line and 95% CI
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.regplot(x='R2014', y='biomass_change', data=df_events, ci=95, scatter_kws={'alpha':0.6})
plt.xlabel('Functional Redundancy (R2014)')
plt.ylabel('Biomass Change Post-MHW')
plt.title('Post-MHW Biomass Change vs Initial Functional Redundancy')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 9. Diagnostic plots
resid = mixed_res.resid
effect_fitted = mixed_res.fittedvalues
plt.figure(figsize=(10,4))
plt.subplot(1,2,1)
plt.scatter(effect_fitted, resid, alpha=0.6)
plt.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Fitted values')
plt.ylabel('Residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted')
plt.subplot(1,2,2)
sm.qqplot(resid, line='s', ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('QQ Plot of Residuals')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

untried_experiments.hypothesis: Species richness in the shallow stratum (≤10 m) has declined more rapidly over 2014–2025 under warming than in the deep stratum (>10 m).

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.regression.mixed_linear_model import MixedLM
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Identify regional MHW years
# Compute region-level mean and SD of SST
stats = df.groupby('region')['mean_sst'].agg(['mean', 'std']).reset_index()
stats['threshold'] = stats['mean'] + 2 * stats['std']
# Compute region-year mean SST
dry = df.groupby(['region', 'year'])['mean_sst'].mean().reset_index()
dry = dry.merge(stats[['region', 'threshold']], on='region')
dry['is_mhw'] = dry['mean_sst'] > dry['threshold']
# List of MHW events
events_list = dry[dry['is_mhw']][['region', 'year']].rename(columns={'year': 'mhw_year'})

# 3. Compute functional redundancy in 2014
df2014 = df[df['year'] == 2014]
# Presence of species per reef
pres = df2014[df2014['biomass'] > 0].drop_duplicates(['id_reef', 'species'])
# Define functional group as floor of trophic level
df2014['func_group'] = np.floor(df2014['trophic_level'])
pres_fg = df2014[df2014['biomass'] > 0].drop_duplicates(['id_reef', 'species', 'func_group'])
# Compute redundancy
r2014 = pres_fg.groupby('id_reef').agg(
    species_richness=('species', 'nunique'),
    n_funcs=('func_group', 'nunique')
).reset_index()
r2014['R2014'] = r2014['species_richness'] / r2014['n_funcs']

# 4. Compute total biomass by reef-year
bio_ry = df.groupby(['id_reef', 'region', 'year'])['biomass'].sum().reset_index()

# 5. For each MHW event, get biomass in MHW year and post-MHW year
# Merge MHW events with biomass
evt = events_list.merge(bio_ry, left_on=['region', 'mhw_year'], right_on=['region', 'year'])
evt = evt.rename(columns={'biomass': 'biomass_mhw'})
# Compute post-MHW year
evt['year_post'] = evt['mhw_year'] + 1
# Merge with biomass to get post-MHW biomass
evt = evt.merge(bio_ry.rename(columns={'year': 'year_post', 'biomass': 'biomass_post'}),
                 on=['id_reef', 'region', 'year_post'], how='left')
# Retain events with post-MHW data
evt = evt.dropna(subset=['biomass_post'])
# Compute biomass change
evt['biomass_change'] = evt['biomass_post'] - evt['biomass_mhw']

# 6. Merge with R2014
df_events = evt.merge(r2014[['id_reef', 'R2014']], on='id_reef', how='left').dropna(subset=['R2014'])

# Deliverable 1: Table of R2014 and biomass changes
print("Summary of redundancy and biomass change for MHW events:")
print(df_events[['id_reef', 'region', 'mhw_year', 'R2014', 'biomass_mhw', 'biomass_post', 'biomass_change']].head())

# 7. Fit mixed model: biomass_change ~ R2014 + random intercepts for region and reef
mixed = MixedLM.from_formula(
    'biomass_change ~ R2014',
    groups='id_reef',
    vc_formula={'region': '0 + C(region)'},
    data=df_events
)
mixed_res = mixed.fit(reml=False)

# Deliverable 2: Model summary
print("\nMixed model results:")
print(mixed_res.summary())

# 8. Scatter plot with regression line and 95% CI
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.regplot(x='R2014', y='biomass_change', data=df_events, ci=95, scatter_kws={'alpha':0.6})
plt.xlabel('Functional Redundancy (R2014)')
plt.ylabel('Biomass Change Post-MHW')
plt.title('Post-MHW Biomass Change vs Initial Functional Redundancy')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 9. Diagnostic plots
resid = mixed_res.resid
effect_fitted = mixed_res.fittedvalues
plt.figure(figsize=(10,4))
plt.subplot(1,2,1)
plt.scatter(effect_fitted, resid, alpha=0.6)
plt.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Fitted values')
plt.ylabel('Residuals')
plt.title('Residuals vs Fitted')
plt.subplot(1,2,2)
sm.qqplot(resid, line='s', ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('QQ Plot of Residuals')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()"}
